name: chirak-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Chirak Sales, Inventory, and Order Management platform.
long_description: Connect AI assistants and autonomous agents to Chirak. Query real-time inventory levels, record sales transactions, manage products and customers, and access revenue analytics via standard Model Context Protocol over STDIO.
